info.name: SGITU - G10 Gateway x G4 Coordination
info.description: Tests Postman complets pour verifier la relation G10 -> G4. G10 valide le JWT, applique le RBAC G4 et route /api/g4/** et /api/v1/operator/status vers le service Coordination.

exec: const payload = { sub: email, userId: String(userId), roles: roles, iat: now, exp: now + ttlSeconds, jti: 'g4-postman-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) };
pm.test('G4 health route via G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('G4 logs accessibles via G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('JWT absent bloque par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('JWT invalide bloque par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('JWT expire bloque par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('ROLE_PASSENGER refuse par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('ROLE_G4_OPERATOR peut lire G4', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('ROLE_DISPATCHER peut lire les missions', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Status supervision reserve a ROLE_G4_ADMIN', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('ROLE_G4_ADMIN peut consulter le statut operateur', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('DISPATCHER ne gere pas les lignes', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Ligne creee via G10 -> G4', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('G4_OPERATOR ne cree pas mission', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Mission creee via G10 -> G4', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Status mission lu via Gateway', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
